claim: The current public author-code revision cannot yet be treated as an exact reproduction of the Nature Photonics paper's first-order Stark rate model because the inspected public helper implements a quadratic polarizability term without the paper's first-order dipole term.

primary_source.title: Overcoming the fill-factor limit of organic solar cells

public_author_code.license_status: No repository-level LICENSE file was observed in the inspected recursive tree; upstream code is therefore not copied into this repository.

decision.effect_on_program: Retain v3.45 as an independent paper-text model counterexample, but do not describe the authors' public code as independently reproduced or as an exact implementation of the paper model until a figure-generating revision is identified.
decision.falsifier: A pinned author-provided revision or archived release whose figure-4 rate path contains the stated first-order Stark term and reproduces the paper figure within a predeclared numerical tolerance would retire this lineage concern.
